trust_decision.summary: Which incoming Collection+JSON / UBER document properties may be written into the target bean is decided in PropertyUtils.createObjectFromProperties, which at the pinned commit invokes any JavaBean setter matching a document key, ignoring the ObjectMapper's Jackson configuration (@JsonIgnore on setters, mixins, visibility, renames).

landing_point.why: Summary names the Collection+JSON deserializers first; CollectionJsonResourceDeserializer (EntityModel) is the most common read path and leads to CollectionJsonItem.toRawData and PropertyUtils.

fix_sites.entry_point: public static PropertyUtils.createObjectFromProperties (called by all CJ/UBER deserializers below)
ObjectMapper.readValue of application/vnd.collection+json into EntityModel/CollectionModel/PagedModel/RepresentationModel (item data path)
UberRepresentationModelDeserializer: readValue of application/vnd.amundsen-uber+json into RepresentationModel subclass
static extractResources used by UberCollectionModelDeserializer (:706) and UberPagedModelDeserializer (:773): readValue into CollectionModel / PagedModel
fix_sites.module_kind: static helper shared by UBER collection deserializers

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/main/java/org/springframework/hateoas/mediatype/PropertyUtils.java:101-122 (public static createObjectFromProperties(Class, Map); fix changes its signature to take a Jackson BeanDescription, fix.diff:25-27, which forces every caller to obtain one from the DeserializationContext, fix.diff:215-221 and fix.diff:323-329)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PropertyUtils already filters @JsonIgnore/@JsonIgnoreProperties by annotation scanning (PropertyUtils.java:246-313), so a solver can argue that reusing those filters in createObjectFromProperties 'honours Jackson' and that mapper-level configuration (mixins, visibility, renames) is a neighbouring feature, not part of the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-ignored properties must still bind from CJ item/template data and UBER data (including RepresentationModel subclasses whose 'links' are skipped), and primitive/scalar content must still short-circuit; dropping all setters without a Jackson-visible property, or rejecting unknown keys, breaks existing round-trip tests.

O6_input_shapes: Collection+JSON items list -> CollectionModel / PagedModel (per item)
ignore expressed on setter only (@JsonIgnore on setter, getter visible) per added tests fix.diff:451-461, fix.diff:548-558

O7_producer.where: Jackson DeserializationConfig/ClassIntrospector obtained from DeserializationContext, fix.diff:215-221 and fix.diff:323-329; at the pinned commit createObjectFromProperties never receives the context (src/main/java/org/springframework/hateoas/mediatype/PropertyUtils.java:101)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second private bean-building helper in the UBER collection path that binds itemData via BeanUtils setters directly instead of via PropertyUtils
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: extractResources is a long static helper already duplicating map-building logic per shape; an inline 'fast path' for flat items is a plausible maintainer shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: template-data binding done through a separate CollectionJsonTemplate.toRawData-style helper mirroring CollectionJsonItem.toRawData
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: items already have a toRawData helper on CollectionJsonItem (CollectionJsonItem.java:195); giving templates the same helper is a natural refactor that a fix focused on items would miss.

O9_family: access control / mass assignment: deserializer bypasses the configured property-binding policy (CWE-284, CWE-915-like)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven (mvnw wrapper), Spring Framework 6.2.19, Jackson 2.19.4, JUnit 5, Lombok

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the existing annotation-scanning @JsonIgnore filters (plus a setter check) inside PropertyUtils.createObjectFromProperties, leaving mapper-level config (mixins, visibility, renames) unhonoured and the context unthreaded.
